To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
transformational leadership is positively related to the organizational culture and organizational culture is positively related to organizational performance.
(1) transformational leadership has a positive effect on organizational culture and (2) organizational culture has a positive effect upon organizational effectiveness.
transformational leadership and organizational culture have a positive relationship, but transactional leadership does not.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between leadership style and organizational culture.
the effects of transformational leadership on the organizational culture and performance of the organization.
how transformational leadership and organizational culture interact and affect employee outcomes, and the mediating mechanisms of the relationship.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

organizational culture is the shared values, beliefs, assumptions, norms and symbols which are common to the members of an organization and that these values are transmitted from one generation to the next.
transformational leadership is a key element of a healthy organizational culture and that the absence of transformational leadership leads to a culture of low morale and poor performance.
transformational leadership is an important factor in organizational culture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transformational leadership and the organizational culture are related.
organizational cultures have a significant effect on leadership effectiveness.

transformational leadership and organizational culture have a positive relationship, with the strongest relationship found in organizations with strong transformational leadership and a strong organizational culture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the culture of the organization matters.
the type of leadership and culture that an organization has can be a predictor of its effectiveness.
the culture of an organization has a significant impact on the leadership styles that are most effective.
